final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), averages AS (SELECT ID, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM averages WHERE share > average_share
